tr.title: library ne demek? (yaygın tuzak)
tr.metaDesc: library ne demek? 'Kitapçı' değil, 'kütüphane'. En çok karıştırılan kelime — LinguaBattle.
tr.lede: library bir tuzaktır: birçok dilde “kitapçı” (kitap satılan dükkân) sanılır ama aslında “kütüphane” (kitap ödünç alınan yer) demektir. (“Kitapçı” = bookshop / bookstore.)

means.en: I bought it at a bookshop. (NOT library)

en.title: What does library mean? (common trap)
en.metaDesc: What does library mean? Not 'bookshop' — it's where you borrow books. A top false-friend — LinguaBattle.
en.lede: library is a trap: in many languages a similar word means “bookshop”, but a library is where you borrow books, not buy them. (To buy books → bookshop / bookstore.)

means.en: I bought it at a bookshop. (NOT library)

de.title: Was bedeutet library? (häufige Falle)
de.metaDesc: Was bedeutet library? Nicht 'Buchhandlung' — sondern 'Bibliothek'. False Friend — LinguaBattle.
de.lede: library ist eine Falle: es heißt NICHT „Buchhandlung“! Es bedeutet „Bibliothek“ (wo man Bücher ausleiht). (Buchhandlung → bookshop / bookstore.)

means.en: I bought it at a bookshop. (NOT library)

fr.title: Que signifie library ? (piège courant)
fr.metaDesc: Que signifie library ? Pas 'librairie' — mais 'bibliothèque'. Faux ami classique — LinguaBattle.
fr.lede: library est un faux ami célèbre : ce n'est PAS « librairie » ! C'est une « bibliothèque » (où on emprunte des livres). (Librairie → bookshop / bookstore.)

means.en: I bought it at a bookshop. (NOT library)

fr.quizQ: Que veut dire « at the library » ?

es.title: ¿Qué significa library? (trampa común)
es.metaDesc: ¿Qué significa library? No 'librería' — sino 'biblioteca'. Falso amigo clásico — LinguaBattle.
es.lede: library es un falso amigo famoso: ¡NO es «librería»! Es una «biblioteca» (donde se prestan libros). (Librería → bookshop / bookstore.)

means.en: I bought it at a bookshop. (NOT library)

ar.title: ماذا تعني library؟ (فخّ شائع)
ar.metaDesc: ماذا تعني library؟ ليست 'مكتبة لبيع الكتب' — بل 'مكتبة للإعارة'. خطأ شائع — LinguaBattle.
ar.lede: library فخّ: تعني «مكتبة عامة» (تستعير منها الكتب)، وليست متجرًا لبيع الكتب. (متجر الكتب → bookshop / bookstore.)

means.en: I bought it at a bookshop. (NOT library)

hi.title: library का क्या मतलब है? (आम ग़लती)
hi.metaDesc: library का क्या मतलब है? 'किताब की दुकान' नहीं — बल्कि 'पुस्तकालय'। आम भ्रम — LinguaBattle.
hi.lede: library एक जाल है: इसका मतलब 'किताब की दुकान' नहीं! इसका मतलब है 'पुस्तकालय' (जहाँ किताबें उधार ली जाती हैं)। ('किताब की दुकान' → bookshop।)

means.en: I bought it at a bookshop. (NOT library)

hi.quizQ: “at the library” का क्या अर्थ है?

ru.title: Что значит library? (частая ловушка)
ru.metaDesc: Что значит library? Не 'книжный магазин' — а 'библиотека'. Частая ошибка — LinguaBattle.
ru.lede: library — ловушка: это «библиотека» (где книги берут на время), а НЕ книжный магазин. (Магазин → bookshop / bookstore.)

means.en: I bought it at a bookshop. (NOT library)

pt.title: O que significa library? (armadilha comum)
pt.metaDesc: O que significa library? Não 'livraria' — mas 'biblioteca'. Falso cognato clássico — LinguaBattle.
pt.lede: library é um falso cognato famoso: NÃO é «livraria»! É uma «biblioteca» (onde se emprestam livros). (Livraria → bookshop / bookstore.)

means.en: I bought it at a bookshop. (NOT library)

ja.title: libraryの意味は？（よくある罠）
ja.metaDesc: libraryの意味は？「書店」ではなく「図書館」。よくある誤用 — LinguaBattle.
ja.lede: library は罠：「書店」ではない！意味は「図書館」（本を借りる場所）。（書店は bookshop / bookstore。）

means.def: コレクション（例：音楽の）

means.en: I bought it at a bookshop. (NOT library)
